title: Page 227
transc:
Wash'n Nov. 11th 1864 
Washn Nov. Eleven To Maj Genl 
AP Hovey period In compliance 
with the request of Maj Genl
Sherman The Secy of War directs 
that you as certain what persons
furnished the in formation respecting Shermans 
alleged movements in the Indianapolis Journal
of the eighth instant period you period you
will are rest them and send
them under guard to such point 
in the Department of the Cumberland
as Maj Gen Thomas may prefer
where they will be employed in
hard labor up on the fortify
cautions until Gen Sherman shall other
wise order sign CA Dana
Assistant Secy of War yours truly


SH Beckwith  Washn Novr 11th 1864
Jennie Hawkins Belly tulip widows sent
squadron have been repeated back tother
prospects When willew be up to
make annual watson wiley Battle
